expectedRealization.rationale: Data-center/AI component orders and mix should affect one to two reporting cycles.

changeHypothesis.summary: AI/high-end passive-component demand remained strong while consumer demand was weaker. 顺络电子 combined H1 profit growth and cash-flow quality with first-party data-center order growth, while its frozen valuation was lower than 三环/风华. This produced a cleaner asymmetry than simply selecting the highest-margin company.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: TrendForce repeatedly showed AI/consumer divergence; 顺络 disclosed important data-center order growth.
disconfirmingEvidence: Consumer weakness can offset AI mix.
三环 has higher absolute margins and broad ceramic optionality.

causalChain.mechanism: AI servers require higher-value power/signal components even when consumer electronics are weak.
causalChain.failureMode: AI capex or customer qualification slows

causalChain.mechanism: Higher-end product mix and utilization can lift profit faster than revenue.
Lower valuation than stronger-branded peers creates room if data-center orders convert.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Jul30 frozen reference valued 顺络 at ~22.2x 2025E; 三环 Aug28 ~30.3x, 风华 Aug21 ~38.8x. 顺络 August price momentum was positive but only mildly above benchmark.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Data-center/AI orders convert into earnings revisions faster than the diversified consumer drag.
expectations.measurableGap: The order signal is first-party and valuation requires less perfection than controls.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward PE plus order/mix revision headroom versus matched passive peers.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Data-center/AI order conversion drives revisions beyond maintained forecasts.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Profit growth only needs to remain above broad consumer-linked peers; no premium multiple is required.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: AI order growth remains too small to offset consumer/input pressure.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Q3/Q4 order and earnings updates should reveal conversion in 20-60d.
